prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Signing into your existing account will automatically restore all your saved pets and progress."]
1: ["Select Starter Companion Accessory"]
2: ["Your pet loves exploring active application windows! You can drag or minimize them anytime."]
3: ["Try hotkey Alt+P to toggle pet visibility on desktop", "Test Summon Hotkey"]
4: ["All custom pets are safely backed up to your account cloud and instantly synced upon signing in."]
5: ["Welcome Your Companion", "Give your new desktop pet a name and select its favorite personality trait.", "Companion Name", "Confirm & Adopt"]
6: ["Your Desktop Pet is Ready!", "Right-click your pet on desktop to open quick actions, or double-click to start a conversation.", "Right-click: Context Menu | Double-click: Chat | Drag: Move around screen"]
7: ["Synthesizing pet desktop animations..."]
8: ["Your pet state and custom assets are safe. Signing in links your desktop companion across all your devices."]
9: ["System Tray Control Active"]
